preregistration.developmentData: The 32 v2.3 exact class disagreements only; held-out debates may not enter the development examples.
preregistration.thresholdChangeRule: No threshold, sample member, or required field may change after a held-out transcript or annotation result is viewed.

debates.motion: Has science refuted religion, or does that claim overreach by confusing scientific method with scientism and by ignoring non-scientific forms of evidence?

debates.stratum: historical claim and asymmetric evidential burden
debates.motion: Did Jesus rise from the dead, and can historical evidence plus allegedly supernatural phenomena justify that conclusion?
Do conscious persons possess nonphysical mental substances that can survive bodily death?

executionProtocol.developmentExamples: Convert all 32 v2.3 class disagreements to the orthogonal v2.4 fields before held-out classification.
executionProtocol.inventory: A fresh task builds each inventory from the full local source with no legacy assessment or development-example access.
executionProtocol.inventoryReview: A different fresh task checks and repairs source fidelity, atomicity, target packets, burdens, and sampling compliance before annotation.
executionProtocol.passA: A fresh isolated 5.6 Sol task uses the exact annotation allowlist and no prior assessment or Pass B.
executionProtocol.passB: A different fresh isolated 5.6 Sol task uses the identical allowlist and no Pass A.
executionProtocol.adjudication: A fresh task resolves every field disagreement without scores or legacy assessments.
executionProtocol.stopRule: Any failed annotation or hard gate blocks numerical scoring and all composition.

readinessRule.passedGate: Authorizes only a separately preregistered complete v2.4 three-debate numerical gate.
readinessRule.tenDebateGate: Not authorized by this annotation-only gate.
